subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should OpenClaw accept `onModelDiagnosticEvent` as a public observability-focused plugin SDK seam for trusted model diagnostics?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but the new export becomes a public plugin SDK compatibility contract and overlaps with prior provider-scoped usage API discussion.

options.title: Accept Narrow Diagnostic Seam

options.title: Defer To Provider-Scoped Usage

options.title: Request A Different API Shape
